subject: ela
cluster: Range of reading and level of text complexity
intro: Eighth graders read and comprehend literary nonfiction at the high end of the grades 6-8 complexity band, independently and proficiently, applying all skills: central idea, strongest evidence, structure, word meaning, author's purpose, and evaluating arguments.

items.prompt:
Read.

The Industrial Revolution transformed society, drawing people to cities for factory work. It created wealth and new jobs, but also child labor and polluted slums.

What is the central idea?

steps: The passage weighs good and bad effects.
So the central idea is that the Industrial Revolution transformed society with both benefits and serious costs.
solution.answer: The Industrial Revolution transformed society, bringing both benefits and serious costs.

items.prompt:
Read (same passage).

Name one NEGATIVE effect.

steps: I find a drawback in the text.
So one negative effect was child labor (or polluted slums).

items.prompt:
Read.

Vaccines train the immune system using a harmless piece of a germ, so the body can fight the real germ later.

How do vaccines work?

steps: They train the immune system with a harmless germ piece.
So vaccines prepare the immune system to fight a germ.
solution.answer: They train the immune system to fight a germ using a harmless piece.

items.prompt:
Read.

Coral reefs support a quarter of ocean life but are dying as seas warm.

Central idea?

Read.

The author urges stricter limits on overfishing.

Purpose?
To support a claim about a text, use the ____ evidence.
